event.description:
*Trade Night Event on 5th Sep, 7pm at GG Adelaide
ENTRY:
- $50
START TIME:
- 11:00 am
FORMAT:
- Constructed
STRUCTURE:
- 60+5 Min Swiss Rounds
- (5 minutes / 3 turns, whichever comes first if, overtime)
- Best of 3
- No Top Cut
- Decklists required

PRIZES:
~~ PROMOS
[1st]
- Regional Champion Playmat

[Top 4/8 depending on attendance]
- Nationals Qualifier Card
- Regionals Finalist Playmats

~~ BOOSTERS
[Participation]
- Grand Archive counters and status indicators
- Booster Pack
- Event Pack
- Each player should get one Sapphire Pack upon entry to the event.

*All remaining Sapphire Packs should be distributed to the top players, with a higher quantity going to the players with a higher placing.
*Each player will get one Event Pack upon entry to the event, all other event packs should be split among the top players.
